analysis: Independent check against the version-6 text. Scope: ROUTE_DEVIATION, safety_flag and complaint_flag absent, no damage/cleaning/violence/harassment/discrimination allegation, so POL-GEN-08(1) does not route it. Integrity: trip_id TRP-04010 matches on EV-TRIP-04010, EV-GPS-04010 and EV-FARE-04010 (RD-10(2) not engaged); trip_record started_at/ended_at equal the first/last fix 22:13:20 / 22:40:32 and no artifact runs backwards (RD-10(4) not engaged). EV-GPS-04010: 165 fixes, max interval 10 s, max consecutive step 166.7 m, max implied speed 60.0 km/h, so the trace is not impaired under POL-RD-07(a)-(c) and RD-10(3) does not arise; recomputed length 16.200 km. EV-FARE-04010 reconciles with Decimal: 3.80 + 12.15 (0.75 x 16.20) + 7.56 (0.28 x 27) + 0.80 = 24.31; METERED, surge 1.0, no ERP, no airport surcharge; every line has a counterpart (RD-10(8) not engaged); billed 16.20 km equals the trace, so no RD-04 unbilled-km limb. Deciding point: EV-TRIP-04010 records a rider-initiated dropoff amendment at 22:21:30 (events destination_changed; EV-CHAT-04010 MSG-04010-003 and SYSTEM MSG-04010-004), so POL-RD-05 requires POL-RD-01 to be re-applied against amended_optimal_distance_km. That field and its duration are null (route_requote_failed 22:21:31). POL-RD-05: 'this clause cannot be run and POL-RD-10(5) applies; the Judge must not derive a substitute figure.' RD-10(5) gives this exact fact pattern as its example. RD-05 is triggered by the trip_record itself, not by which party cites it, so the alternative path of discarding the driver's uncited assertion and measuring against the booked 9.8 km (excess 6.400 km, 65.31 %; careless RD-02 gives 24.31 - 16.15 = 8.16 -> 8.20) is foreclosed by RD-01, whose optimal is the RD-05 adjusted figure where RD-05 applies. POL-RD-13(1) narrows RD-10(5) only for uncited traffic assertions and does not reach RD-05. Measurements that cannot substitute for the re-quote: 6.219 km before 22:21:30 (never excess against the driver under RD-05) and 9.982 km after; amendment point (1.366657, 103.939921) is 7.548 km straight-line from PLQ (ratio 1.322), so whether the post-amendment leg exceeds an amended optimal by > 20 % and > 0.8 km depends on the missing figure. No other clause rescues the case: RD-03/RD-13 (no traffic cause asserted; EV-ADVIS-04010-01 MISSING and uncited), RD-04 (destination change is RD-05's case; waypoint_hint null, no road named), RD-14 (no uncorroborated detour; the car reached PLQ), RD-11/RD-12 (METERED, RYDE_X), RD-07 (trace clean), POL-GEN-07 (a clause does name the outcome). POL-NS-01 to POL-NS-12 belong to NO_SHOW_CHARGE and do not apply. Ruling ESCALATE, amounts null, referrals [], governing clauses POL-RD-05 and POL-RD-10, difficulty INDETERMINATE: the key is right on every point. Side note, not a defect: the platform's 5.15 deduction does not match any RD-02 figure on the record (booked-optimal recompute would be 8.20); both readers noticed it, it is context for the reviewer and does not support any other ruling, so no case change is warranted.
